title: Lux Bonteri
subtitle: Renegade Separatist
text: When an opponent plays a card: If that opponent paid less than the card's cost to play it, ready or exhaust a unit.
rules:
Abilities that refer to a card's cost always refer to its printed cost, regardless of modifiers.
"Paid less than the card's cost to play it" means the opponent paid fewer resources than the card's printed cost.
